questions.stem: Why is it important for body temperature to be maintained at approximately 37 degrees C?

options.text: So that blood can flow easily through vessels
So that water does not evaporate from the skin
So that enzymes can function at their optimum rate
So that oxygen dissolves better in the blood

questions.explanation: Enzymes work best at around 37 degrees C. If body temperature varies too much, enzymes may denature or work too slowly, which would disrupt vital metabolic reactions.
